## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VIX/VXX signal neutral (VIX NEUTRAL; VXX (1W: -5.68% | 1M: -22.72%) BELOW TREND shows one-sided volatility decline) and Stocks vs Bonds neutral (SPY_TLT NEUTRAL); Tech strength (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%)) contrasts with Energy in CORRECTION (XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%)), yielding mixed leadership.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress neutral: HYG (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.28%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.63% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND → HYG/LQD NEUTRAL. Fear/volatility flat: VIX NEUTRAL while equities modestly higher via SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%) indicating selective risk appetite.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: UUP in RECOVERY (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -1.41%) and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +0.74%) — dollar softening but rates broadly steady, so financial conditions neither tightening nor easing materially.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Technology leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%). Financials showing strength: XLF (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +2.42%) — Industrials mixed with XLI CORRECTION (1W: -0.54% | 1M: +1.21%). Style: Growth tilted but breadth only moderate.

**5. US vs Global?**
US solid: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%); EM participation evident with EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +10.71%). China lagging: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -2.44%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
High speculative risk-on: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.93% | 1M: +25.81%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +23.80%) show elevated flows, while IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +3.90%) confirms small-cap participation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals strong: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +13.88%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +21.25%). Industrial metals supportive with CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +4.25%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed to soft: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +2.54%) while NatGas via UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +5.04%) shows idiosyncratic strength.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%) — core equity trend intact. DIVERGENCES: multiple sector CORRECTIONS (XLE, MTUM, XLY) are minor but warrant monitoring; no MAJOR divergence across SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective exposure to growth/tech ETFs (XLK, QQQ) and thematic/speculative exposure (IBIT, ARKK) while monitoring energy (XLE) and utilities (XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -3.35%)) for weakness; maintain neutral duration posture with TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +0.74%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%) and XBI (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +13.74%) — momentum leaders. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%) and XLU (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -3.35%) — watch for follow-through.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: SLV (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +21.25%) and CPER (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +4.25%). BEARISH: BNO (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +2.54%) — energy retracement risk.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (volatility complacency marker); HYG/LQD parity ~0.80 (credit health reference); XLK/XLF spread (~2.0) as growth vs value pivot; IBIT momentum breakout levels near recent highs (monitor for extension).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, mixed leadership between robust tech and lagging defensives. XLK and growth/theme ETFs showing strength while energy and several sector CORRECTIONS are key divergence risks to monitor.
